dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: This study uses two main datasets: (1) EU-AIMS LEAP (Longitudinal European Autism Project), a large multicenter observational study from 6 European sites (Cambridge, London, Mannheim, Nijmegen, Rome, Utrecht) with 274 individuals with autism and 219 control subjects; (2) Healthy Brain Network (HBN), an independent transdiagnostic pediatric cohort recruited in New York with 352 individuals in the relaxed sample (SRS-2 T-score > 60) and 79 in the stringent sample (SRS-2 T-score > 76).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We analyzed data from the EU-AIMS LEAP (18). This cohort is a large multicenter observational study, which aims to identify and validate stratification biomarkers in autism." ... "We conducted analyses in the Healthy Brain Network (34), an independent transdiagnostic mental health pediatric cohort recruited in New York, New York."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Laidi2022.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Participants; Laidi2022.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Dimensional Analyses in a Transdiagnostic Pediatric Cohort

answer.LEAP: normative model training (controls) and clinical application (autism patients); case-control analyses

answer.HBN: dimensional analyses in an independent transdiagnostic pediatric cohort for validation

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: EU-AIMS LEAP was used for (1) training the normative model using control subjects with 10-fold cross-validation, (2) applying the model to individuals with autism to generate deviation maps, and (3) case-control comparisons. The Healthy Brain Network (HBN) was used as an independent cohort for dimensional analyses to study the influence of autism-related symptoms (SRS-2 T-score) on cerebellar anatomy.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "A Gaussian process regression model was trained at each voxel in the control cohort using age, sex, site of inclusion, FSIQ, and intracranial volume (ICV) as covariates to predict cerebellar gray matter volume." ... "In this more heterogenous population of individuals with autism-related symptoms without a formal diagnosis of autism, we studied the influence of the clinical dimensions of autism using the SRS-2 T score"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Laidi2022.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling; Laidi2022.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Dimensional Analyses in a Transdiagnostic Pediatric Cohort

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative model was trained using 219 neurotypical control subjects from the EU-AIMS LEAP cohort. The study used 10-fold cross-validation in neurotypical individuals to avoid overfitting and assess generalizability, then retrained the model on the entire control sample to make predictions in individuals with autism. The exact number of subjects in each fold is not reported.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "A Gaussian process regression model was trained at each voxel in the control cohort using age, sex, site of inclusion, FSIQ and ICV as covariates to predict cerebellar grey matter volume... To avoid overfitting, assess generalizability, and determine whether neurotypical individuals fall within the normative range, we used 10-fold cross-validation in neurotypical individuals before retraining the model in the entire sample to make predictions in individuals with autism."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The control subjects (n=219) used for normative model training had a mean age of 17 years (SD=5), with a range of 6-30 years. There was no significant difference in age between patients (mean=17, SD=5, range 7-30) and control subjects. The 10-fold cross-validation does not provide separate train-phase statistics.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The control subjects had 64% males, implying 36% females. From 219 control subjects: 140 males (64%) and 79 females (36%). Sex ratio was calculated from the percentage given in Table 1 (219 * 0.64 = 140.16 ≈ 140 males; 219 - 140 = 79 females). Train-phase sex breakdown is not separately reported due to 10-fold cross-validation approach.
